ui_bugs.issue: Pending invites row renders 'Awaiting signup · sent Invalid Date' because line 125 does `new Date(inv.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')` but shopInvites.createdAt is a Firestore Timestamp (or serverTimestamp() placeholder), not a unix-ms number. Fix: reuse the same toMs()+fmt() pattern already in super-admin/index.tsx / super-admin/shop/[id].tsx — e.g. `const ms = inv.createdAt?.toDate?.().getTime() ?? (typeof inv.createdAt === 'number' ? inv.createdAt : inv.createdAt?.seconds ? inv.createdAt.seconds*1000 : null); const dateStr = ms ? new Date(ms).toLocaleDateString('en-IN') : '—';`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx:125

When a staff user visits /admin directly, `<Redirect href='/(tabs)/settings'>` correctly prevents the admin content from rendering (page is blank), but the URL bar stays at /admin on web instead of updating to /settings. Behaviourally safe (no owner content leaks to staff), but the acceptance criterion in iteration_19 flow 6e said 'redirects back to /(tabs)/settings' — strictly by URL the redirect does not happen on web. Consider `useEffect(()=>{ if (user.role==='staff') router.replace('/(tabs)/settings') })` instead of <Redirect> for URL correctness. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx:220-222

rca_of_issue: RCA (new /admin/users Invalid Date): /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx line 125 does `new Date(inv.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')`. shopInvites.createdAt is written as a Firestore serverTimestamp() (see /app/frontend/src/firebase/invites.ts writeInvite) and comes back as a Timestamp instance on read, not a millisecond number, so `new Date(timestamp)` yields Invalid Date. Same class as the super-admin bug that was just fixed in iteration_19 via toMs()/fmt() helpers — apply the same pattern here (or extract to a shared util).
